_doc: Generated by game/tools/sprite_pipeline.gd (FLEET_PACK.md T-016). Schema: id, name, tbd, world_height (DESIGN.md section 5 body-size table, SR-2; null where the section gives the enemy no row), animations[] {name, fps, loop, frames[] (paths relative to this folder), body_rect[] (tight bbox of alpha > 16 per frame, the HITBOXES shape), world_height per animation/frame where it differs}, sources[] = the ENEMIES.md 'Attachment mapping' state. Resourced at res://content/enemies/<id>/sprites.json.

anim._doc: T-083 (research/fable-tickets.md section 1.11 - the table is the spec; ENEMIES.md frozen, D-040). One entry per state of the section 1.11 table. Frames are file names relative to this folder (the T-016 names): the eight logo states carry REAL art derived from assets_src/enemies/claudelogo.png by game/tools/art/claude.gd (spawn = spawn_00.png, idle = idle_00.png, telegraph_drums = telegraph_drums_00.png, attack_drums = attack_drums_00.png, telegraph_strings = telegraph_strings_00.png, attack_strings = attack_strings_00.png, attack_wind = attack_wind_00.png, deadline = deadline_00.png; idle_01/idle_02 are the +15 deg metronome step and the 1.06x pulse pose filling the sheet's idle 3-frame set). NO plushie frames exist yet (the clawd Crab plushie source was never fetched - TBD fallback): plushie_00/01/02.png are magenta TBD placeholders standing in for spec plushie_00..02, looping at the table's 6 fps (10 ticks per frame). The eight logo states each show one distinct real frame; plushie_idle is the only TBD row (tbd=true). The timings stay exactly as the table says. Driven by the SIM state and its tick counter, never a wall-clock timer; a telegraph fills its cue exactly and the attack frame/ring lands on the beat the attack resolves.

spawn.timing_note: common fade (section 1.0): alpha 0 -> 1 over 30 ticks, scale 0.8 -> 1.0; the body cannot touch or kill until the fade completes

idle.timing_note: the logo rotates 15 deg per beat IN STEPS (a metronome); scale pulse 1.0 -> 1.06 on every beat (beat = 36 ticks at 100 BPM, shortened by the current tempo) - no per-frame cadence; beat-driven from the SIM's beat counter

telegraph_drums.timing_note: the beat BEFORE beats 1 and 3 (one full beat, 36 ticks at 100 BPM, shortened by the current tempo); a red ring at its feet shows the plane the ring will travel in; the logo flashes white on the hit beat

params.band: 1.0 u tall translucent red band, as YOU?!'s

attack_drums.timing_note: shown on the hit beat; the ring starts on the beat (12 u/s to radius 18 u; 18 / 12 = 1.5 s = 90 ticks to full); the hit lands at 36 ticks into the cue's beat order - the telegraph (the beat before) fills its cue exactly and this lands on the beat the attack resolves

telegraph_strings.timing_note: one full beat (36 ticks at 100 BPM, shortened by the current tempo); a red line 24 u long at the sweep's starting angle

attack_strings.timing_note: sweep of 120 deg over 4 beats (144 ticks at 100 BPM, shortened by the current tempo); red beam 1.5 u wide at 0.5-1.5 u height

params.dies_on: any tile slab or step riser (>= 1 HU), and on any prop (D-071)

attack_wind.timing_note: shots leave on beats 1, 2, 3; each shot: a white notification dot 0.5 u with a red rim and a trail

deadline.timing_note: agitation 100 (Deadline): claude_00 with a red tint, loop, until a plushie is collected; at Deadline all three attacks fire every bar; tempo = 160 BPM

plushie_idle.timing_note: loop at 6 fps (10 ticks per frame); TBD stand-in: no plushie frames exist (the clawd Crab plushie source was never fetched - TBD fallback, TBD.md), so the three TBD magenta placeholders plushie_00..02.png stand in (at the table's exact 6 fps); bob +- 0.1 u; soft white glow; collected = pop 9 ticks
